components.css: .ds-theme-row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:64px;padding:9px 10px 0;background:#E5F1EC;color:#182B29;font:10pt "Microsoft YaHei UI","Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI",sans-serif;}.ds-theme-row strong{font-weight:700;}.ds-theme-row span{margin-top:5px;font-size:9pt;color:#176B58;}.ds-theme-row:focus-visible{outline:1px dotted #176B58;outline-offset:-2px;}

narrative.overview:
The interface is a clear, concise working environment for Chinese-speaking Malody V players and theme authors. Neutral surfaces, restrained green actions and familiar Windows controls keep attention on the next task. Brand appears through the existing logo and real theme artwork.

The native Windows typography, frame, dialogs, scrollbars and focus cues are intentional. This system records the implemented WinForms application; the surface brief owns its workflow composition and the disclosed concept-workflow deviation.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet light surfaces with a restrained green accent.
Native Chinese typography and keyboard affordances.
Persistent task labels and truthful operation states.
Real source artwork with proportion-preserving previews.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with words or an enabled, disabled or selected control state; color alone does not explain the result.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Keep Chinese interface text on the native UI family chain and retain point-based font sizes. System typography is the deliberate choice for this task workspace.

dos: Do keep the shared palette, native type chain and point-based text sizing consistent.
Do keep labels visible and provide distinct empty, invalid, busy and disabled states.
Do keep theme rows within the list width and retain vertical scrolling at supported minimum sizes.
Do preserve keyboard focus, accessible names and Ctrl+F, Ctrl+O and F5 shortcuts.
Do use real theme artwork and preserve its aspect ratio.
donts: Don't add gradients, decorative cards or an oversized empty branding panel to this working utility.
Don't use generated or substituted artwork for the Default theme.
Don't style unavailable actions as enabled or expose empty metadata as a selected theme.
Don't treat synthetic 150% captures as physical DPI verification.
